Join FoodHero, an innovative app that connects food merchants with consumers to combat the global issue of food waste. Approximately 40% of all the food produced worldwide goes to waste each year, contributing to the depletion of valuable resources. FoodHero is on a mission to change that and create a better world. At FoodHero, we believe in fostering a working environment where individuals can thrive, grow, and contribute to a meaningful cause. Join us in reducing food waste and building a sustainable future while enjoying a dynamic and engaging workplace that values trust, respect, fun, community, passion, accountability, and humility. About the position We are looking for a BI intern to support the transition of our BI reporting to PowerBI, participate in the redesign of analytical models, and implement reliable, actionable, and clear dashboards. This summer job is an excellent opportunity to develop your mastery of the PowerBI tool. Deadline to apply: 12 th of April 2026. Period of employment: beginning of May until end of August 2026. Responsibilities • Contribute to the creation of reports in PowerBI from Excel according to specifications defined by the BI team. • Participate in the improvement and maintenance of Power BI dashboards under the supervision of the BI team. • Actively participate in BI team meetings to design data models for analytics (facts, dimensions, indicators). Contribute to the validation of data shared with stakeholders to ensure it is clear, reliable, and actionable. • See job description in French on the employer's website. Job Requirements Skills and qualifications • Training in business intelligence, data analysis, or a related field. • Strong interest in data modeling, visualization, and validation. • Strong motivation to learn Power BI and best practices in business intelligence. • Ability to structure, document, and communicate results clearly. • Bilingual in French and English. • Basic knowledge of databases (SQL or NoSQL). • ASSET - Knowledge of PowerBI, DAX, Power Query, star schema modeling. • ASSET - Knowledge of a programming language. ASSET - Comfortable with machine learning methods in Python (supervised learning, unsupervised learning). • Citizenship Requirement N/A APPLICATION INFORMATION Application Procedure Through Employer Website Special Application Instructions Application Link: BambooHR Please click the "I intend to apply to this position" button on SCOPE and also submit your application via the employer's website.
